cat > /tmp/qemu-control.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /tmp
rm -f alpine-disk.qcow2 qemu-run.log
cp /app/alpine-disk.qcow2 alpine-disk.qcow2

# Start QEMU and capture output, with stdin piped for interaction
timeout 300 qemu-system-x86_64 \
  -m 1024 \
  -cdrom /app/alpine.iso \
  -hda alpine-disk.qcow2 \
  -net user,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 \
  -net nic \
  -nographic \
  2>&1 &

QEMU_PID=$!
echo "QEMU PID: $QEMU_PID"

# Wait for boot
sleep 12

# Send input to configure SSH
(
  # Wait for login prompt
  sleep 2
  echo "root"
  sleep 1
  
  # Check if we're at a shell or need to install
  echo "apk update"
  sleep 2
  echo "apk add openssh openssh-server"
  sleep 3
  echo "sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config"
  sleep 1
  echo "sed -i 's/#PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config"
  sleep 1
  echo "echo 'root:password123' | chpasswd"
  sleep 1
  echo "/etc/init.d/sshd start"
  sleep 2
  echo "exit"
) | timeout 120 qemu-system-x86_64 \
  -m 1024 \
  -cdrom /app/alpine.iso \
  -hda /tmp/alpine-disk.qcow2 \
  -net user,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 \
  -net nic \
  -nographic \
  2>&1 | tee /tmp/qemu-run.log

wait $QEMU_PID 2>/dev/null || true
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/qemu-control.sh
